notes.title: Version 2.0 → 2.1 Update Complete
notes.content:
October 3, 2022

We have completed our planned updates for hololive ERROR: the Game.

◆ Version 2.1 patch notes
・Improved performance during gameplay
・As an emergency measure, in the case of a black screen game freeze, the player will be returned to the start of the current chapter
・Minor bugfixes (collision boxes, visual glitches, etc.)
・Correction of some game text
・Changed the display of some item names
・Changed behavior when starting new game after previous playthrough
└In addition to unlocked archives persisting, unlocked chapters will also persist in the chapter select menu

You can update your game to the latest version from the Steam library.
If you have not turned on automatic updates in Steam, you can do so by right clicking the game from your library page, selecting "Properties," and configuring it under the "Updates" menu.

Thank you for your continued support of hololive ERROR.

notes.title: Announcement of Update for Version 2.0
notes.content:
September 29, 2022

We are currently implementing several updates to improve your hololive ERROR: the Game experience.
Note: These updates will not involve additional content, visuals, or effects.

We plan to release the version 2.1 update on Monday, October 3rd.
Thank you for your patience.
